blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Bloomberry Resorts Corp. swung to a consolidated net loss of P915.5 million in the first nine months of 2026 from a net income of P160.1 million a year earlier. Back then, its bottom line got a P2.9-billion boost from a one-time refinancing gain. On Monday, the Enrique Razon Jr.-led company said the prior-year […]...
